name: @arena/expert-calibration
description: Arena expert calibration (Work Order C004; issue #111) — the quality flywheel of the expert network. CalibrationProgram: a versioned, content-addressed composition of calibration probes per capability (A004 vocabulary via the C003/A007 seams), each probe pinned to evaluator/verifier criteria with declared minimum evidence (EV1.0 Certification Suite discipline), deterministic and reproducible given identical inputs (seeded ordering, injected times — no hidden clocks). Calibration records compare expert-PREDICTED confidence/score against LATER-OBSERVED outcomes per LE1.0 Calibration, each preserving full applicability context (capability, domain, environment); append-only and content-addressed; backdated outcome injection fails closed. Drift verdicts are TYPED (calibrated / overconfident / underconfident / insufficient-sample / stale) — never a bare score. The pre-training track derives gap-filling assignments from the C003 intake gap-list for execution through the A017 workbench surface with an explicit pre-trained / not-yet state; completion PROPOSES a qualification update to A007 (a proposal, never a direct write). The requalification policy declares freshness windows + closed triggers (time, drift verdict, domain-pack change, dispute); expiry produces a typed status-transition proposal in the A007 vocabulary (quality-model REVOKED law: revocation is a transition, history remains auditable) — enforcement belongs to the A007/routing consumers. A calibration verdict is DATA, never an authorization (lock rules 9/35): consuming calibration output as an access grant fails closed. Tenant isolation at the domain level.
